estimation_limit: compressed-size ratios from N20 are planning heuristics only; neither scenario count nor full raw/compact size has a proven statistical or mathematical upper bound. No N or town prediction.

A_full_raw_retention.estimate_formula: N20 inventoried member bytes * historical full compressed size / N20 prefix bytes; excludes filesystem and TAR overhead
A_full_raw_retention.risk: all images/sensor payloads, filesystem overhead and a separate compressed archive compete with existing evidence; no deletion of historical files to create space

B_streamed_compact_extraction.scientific_constraint: clean features alone cannot regenerate raw pixel/temporal pseudo corruptions after new FIT/CAL membership; retain the separate full compressed archive and replay raw inputs scenario-by-scenario after partition freeze
workflow: compressed stream -> sequential scenario verification and exact member hashes
unchanged clean feature extractor -> partition-independent compact block and durable source/schema/code/window bindings
seal block and provenance; keep independent compressed archive as exact raw reproduction source
release only authorized NEW scenario temporary extraction
after full inventory/partition freeze and later pseudo authorization, replay retained local archive to recreate required CAL/FIT raw windows; never use historical pseudo rows
seal role-specific pseudo provenance before releasing recreated temporary raw inputs
B_streamed_compact_extraction.compact_projection_formula: N20 ten-scenario new-clean block bytes * 2 * remote/prefix ratio; may over/underestimate future diversity and duration
B_streamed_compact_extraction.cap_exceed_response: pause and report resource requirement; preserve verified blocks/provenance/stream state; never exclude a scientifically eligible scenario or label partial traversal complete. Additional capacity/budget requires review.
B_streamed_compact_extraction.no_extra_full_archive_copy: new staging copy is itself the final full archive; do not hold a second duplicate full archive
B_streamed_compact_extraction.feature_reproducibility: archive SHA-256 plus source ETag/size/URL, per-member SHA-256/size/name/offset, scenario identity, feature code/schema/window/preprocessing/dependency versions, block bytes/content hashes; archive retention persists through pseudo work and audit

extra_costs: retained archive replay after partition freeze
later fitting and graph training not estimated or executed here
runtime.continuation_bytes_estimate_only: N20 acquisition elapsed time is a historical observation; future throughput/network is unmeasured
controls: one scenario workspace, deterministic fixed causal windows
monitor free disk before writes and each boundary
atomic publication only after complete block/provenance verification
durable checkpoint and failure ledger, no silent overwrite

cleanup_policy.allowed_only: explicitly owned new Experiment-2 temporary raw data with durable archive/member/block provenance already verified
required_before_delete: resolve absolute path inside approved new staging temp root
reject symlink/junction and ancestor of historical evidence
confirm ownership ledger and exact scenario
confirm required raw reproduction archive retained and verified
confirm no pending pseudo/feature reader needs temporary data
cleanup_policy.retain_on_failure: preserve new diagnostic manifests/hash ledger and verified archive state; report partial temp data; no sweeping cleanup of unrelated artifacts

recommendation: verified continuation into one separately retained compressed archive with compact clean blocks and bounded scenario temporary raw extraction/replays; remote feasibility and resource admission must be rechecked after separate authorization
